feature.title: 対局スナップショットと閲覧制御
flow: GetSnapshot dispatches to the per-game actor, which reads the durable version and reconstructs changed or invalid state from validated receipts.
GetSnapshotForViewer reads access metadata and history coherently; CheckViewAccess reads current access metadata without requesting the journal.

GameRpc converts the owned application snapshot into board pieces, all hand counters, legal USI moves, permanent participants, turn/check/result and sequence; the browser gateway authenticates viewer claims separately.

guarantees.statement: A successful trusted snapshot returns durable sequence, permanent participants, an owned board and 14 hand counters, turn/check/result and legal moves; finished positions are retained with no legal moves.
Public games permit authenticated spectators through the gateway. Private games permit participants. Viewer snapshot/access RPCs hide inaccessible and missing games as NotFound.
Snapshots refresh durable version, fail closed on read failure and reject corrupt history/metadata; restart restores ongoing and finished snapshots.

contracts.statement: Ordinary snapshot requests refresh durable version before serving actor state; storage failure cannot fall back to the cached position.

source.needle: async fn refresh(&mut self) -> Result<(), ApplicationError> {

evidence.reason: Closing the real pool makes cached service snapshot return Unavailable.
Across two service restarts ongoing and finished snapshots equal saved snapshots.

contracts.statement: Domain positions and cloned games own their board, hands and terminal result independently.

evidence.reason: Mutating a game does not change a previously returned position.
Clones retain independent position and result through move/resign mutations.

contracts.statement: Snapshot conversion includes participant bindings, sequence, occupied board squares, both players/all hand kinds, turn/check/result and legal USI moves.

evidence.reason: TCP assertions check initial sequence/40 pieces/14 zero hands/Black turn/30 moves and selected capture/promotion/drop values; resignation retains position and returns result with empty legal moves.

contracts.gap: The selected transport test does not compare the complete board/hand ordering or every piece/enum conversion branch.

contracts.statement: snapshot_for_viewer uses one repository access/history view, rejects access or game-identity mismatch and reconstructs the owned snapshot.

evidence.reason: Private outsider and absent viewer snapshot are NotFound while participant snapshot succeeds.

contracts.gap: No concurrent privacy plus history mutation test independently establishes the complete coherent viewer-read contract.

contracts.statement: Public visibility or permanent participant membership permits access; CheckViewAccess uses metadata without loading history.

evidence.reason: Private outsider and missing access RPCs are NotFound; participant access succeeds and existing public spectator closes after privacy changes.

contracts.gap: No query-count assertion proves the access-only operation skips history, and every storage/access corruption branch is not enumerated.

contracts.statement: GetSnapshotForViewer and CheckViewAccess validate game/viewer IDs, forward caller viewer claims and map application errors without authenticating the claim.

evidence.reason: Generated TCP RPCs assert both private/missing errors and participant success through real gateway fixture services.

contracts.gap: Malformed viewer/game ID boundaries are not individually asserted on both viewer RPCs.

contracts.statement: Restoration validates receipt sequence, uniqueness, participant legality, acceptance and final metadata while replaying from the standard initial game.

evidence.reason: Changed check/USI/owner/request, version, terminal metadata and deleted receipt all yield Corrupt on restoration.
Restored ongoing and finished snapshots equal their earlier snapshots.

contracts.statement: PostgreSQL joins game metadata and ordered receipts in one coherent read; viewer read applies its visibility filter to that view.

evidence.reason: Concurrent writer/read loop compares version with journal length and final result with last receipt; independent snapshot reconstruction succeeds.
Viewer read exercises the private/participant access paths.

contracts.gap: Concurrent ordinary joined reads are asserted; concurrent viewer visibility/history changes are not independently asserted.

limitations: Trusted gRPC caller user/viewer IDs are claims; authentication belongs to the gateway. GetSnapshot is an internal trusted read.
No independent query-count or concurrent privacy/history assertion covers every viewer-read implementation property.
Links and passing tests do not establish semantic completeness; changes to guarantees, evidence strength and decomposition require review.
